module_summary: dash_settings.c is the dashboard SETTINGS screen: static SetItem/SetPage tables describe every page, and choiceInfo/setChoice/numberInfo/pathInfo/runAction map a SetId to the underlying SETTING (classic LAUNCHSTATION.CNF), dashCfg (DASHBOARD.CNF), dashTheme or IP globals. It holds a Save/Discard session (byte snapshots plus the save text, refreshDirty), queues CNF/IPCONFIG writes on the background worker (cfgSave), and contains a colour editor, a date/time editor, theme folder import/export jobs, and an SMB/NFS share editor that splices blocks into LAUNCHSTATION.CNF via smb_shares.c. It exports dashSettingsScreen, dashSettingsSaveCnf (used by dash_apps.c and dash_browser.c) and dashSettingsOpenLaunchKeys (dash_main.c).

findings.title: Eight SetIds with no Settings row (S_LEGACY_THEME, S_ENABLED, S_FILES_MODE, S_LAUNCHKEYS, S_IGR_*, S_SMB_SHARES, S_T_CUSTOMIZE) and their cases
findings.problem: choiceInfo, setChoice, runAction and runThemeAction are static and are only called with ids from the SetItem tables (lines 234-873) or from the constant lists at 3550-3557 and 3693-3695. None of these eight ids appears in any table or list, so their cases never run. dash_store.c:309 and :325 also force enabled/legacy_theme to 1, so the S_ENABLED/S_LEGACY_THEME setters are obsolete; files_mode is toggled from dash_files.c:693 instead. The cases for S_LEGACY_THEME, S_ENABLED and S_FILES_MODE are dead.
findings.fix: Delete the eight enum entries, the stale 'Legacy/internal split flags' comment, and the matching cases in choiceInfo, setChoice, runThemeAction and runAction. Update the two source-text tests: drop S_IGR_AUTO_BACKUP from the list in test_igr_return_policy.py, and point test_native_cloud.py at the live S_IGR_SYNC_MODE branch (1830-1834), which already checks cloudGoogleIsLinked().
findings.benefit: ~56 source lines removed; switch cases in static functions are compiled in, so a few hundred bytes of .text are saved (INFERRED, not measured)
findings.evidence: Grep over src/Launchstation for S_LEGACY_THEME|S_ENABLED|S_FILES_MODE|S_LAUNCHKEYS|S_IGR_AUTO_BACKUP|S_IGR_CLOUD_SYNC|S_SMB_SHARES|S_T_CUSTOMIZE: only the enum lines and the cited cases in dash_settings.c, plus tests/test_igr_return_policy.py:24 and tests/test_native_cloud.py:114 (source-text asserts). All 873 table lines were read: none of these ids is in a table. runAction is otherwise called only from settingsInput:3839 (it->id), the S_CLOCK list 3569 (S_CLOCK_MANUAL/SYNC/SOFTWARE/HARDWARE) and settingsMenu 3693-3695 (S_SAVE_CLASSIC, S_REVERT), so those ids stay live. dash_store.c:239,247,255,309,325,343 read.

findings.title: Unused ST_INFO item type, unused choiceInfo 'single' out-parameter and write-only TargetsJob.finished
findings.problem: No SetItem uses ST_INFO, so the draw branch that prints ip/netmask (3965-3972) and its icon case never run. choiceInfo always sets *single = NULL, and neither caller reads it. targetsDone sets j->finished, but nothing reads that field: saveClassicAs uses dashWorkerAwait's result and j->abandoned.
findings.fix: Delete ST_INFO, its icon case and the draw branch. Drop the 'single' parameter from choiceInfo and its two callers, plus the stub signature in tests/test_settings_navigation.py. Delete the finished field and the assignment.
findings.evidence: Grep ST_INFO over src/Launchstation: dash_settings.c:28, 3962, 3965 only (other matches are DASH_TOAST_INFO). Grep 'single' in dash_settings.c: 1004, 1007 (assignment), 3812/3813 and 3997/3998 (declared and passed, never read). Grep 'finished' over src/Launchstation *.c *.h: dash_settings.c:2650 (field) and 2665 (write) only. tests/test_settings_navigation.py:111 stubs choiceInfo with the same 4-parameter signature.

findings.title: Classic screen-defaults block copied in resetScreen, resetDisplayThemeDefaults and config_screen.c
findings.problem: The same 14 statements (eight DEF_COLORn colours, TV_mode Auto, screen_x/y = 0, Menu_Frame, Popup_Opaque, updateScreenMode) appear three times. Both dash_settings.c copies and config_screen.c (compiled, ps2.yaml:514) match line for line. config.c's defaults function sets the same fields in a slightly different order.
findings.fix: Keep one copy as a non-static function next to the defaults in config.c (or as a static function in dash_settings.c if only the two local copies are merged). Then make resetScreen, resetDisplayThemeDefaults and the config_screen.c DEFAULT branch call it.
findings.justification: The helper replaces three identical 14-line blocks: 42 lines become about 16 (one function) plus 3 calls, a net removal of about 23 lines, and the reset defaults can no longer drift apart.
findings.benefit: ~23 lines removed net if all three copies share it (~11 if only the two in dash_settings.c); a few hundred bytes of .text (INFERRED: three inlined copies of 13 stores and a call)
findings.evidence: Read dash_settings.c:2766-2811 and config_screen.c:150-186; Grep '= DEF_COLOR1;' over src/Launchstation: config_screen.c:166, config.c:845, dash_settings.c:2770, 2791. Duplicate lead dupes-blocks.tsv lists the same three 14-line ranges. ps2.yaml:514 compiles src/config_screen.c, :599 src/dash_settings.c.

findings.title: Auto-start device id-to-bit mapping written twice (six choiceInfo cases and a setChoice ternary)
findings.problem: choiceInfo has seven cases that differ only in the DASH_DEVA_* constant (S_DEVA_UDPFS leaves out the boot-device test, which is harmless because dashBootDeviceBit never returns UDPFS, dash_devices.c:895-918). setChoice maps the same ids to bits again with a 6-way ternary.
findings.fix: Add one small static id-to-bit function, use it in setChoice in place of the ternary, and collapse the choiceInfo cases into one case group: cur = (dev_auto & bit) || dashBootDeviceBit() == bit.
findings.justification: The helper replaces two copies of the same mapping: 23 + 6 lines become about 8 + 6 + 1, a net removal of about 11 lines, and a device added later needs one edit instead of two.
findings.benefit: ~11 lines removed net (INFERRED from cited ranges); negligible size change
findings.evidence: Read dash_settings.c:1130-1152 and 1729-1768; read dash_devices.c:895-918 (dashBootDeviceBit returns USB/HDD/ATA/MMCE/MX4SIO/ILINK or 0, never UDPFS).

findings.title: Redundant statements: second LK_Flag update in pathApplied, no-op keep_enabled/keep_view in editScanPaths, presetPreview forwarder
findings.problem: pathApplied sets LK_Flag for S_ESR_PATH/S_OSDSYS_PATH at 2111-2114, and 2134-2137 sets the same flags again with nothing in between that returns early for those ids. In editScanPaths 'Restore defaults', saved is a full copy of the old dashCfg with only scan/nscan replaced, so dashCfg = saved already keeps enabled and view; keep_enabled/keep_view do nothing. presetPreview only forwards to dashThemeSetPreset(int), which already has the void (*)(int) type that dashModalSetPreview takes (dash_internal.h:951, :260).
findings.fix: Delete lines 2134-2137. Delete keep_enabled/keep_view and their two restore assignments. Delete presetPreview and pass dashThemeSetPreset to dashModalSetPreview.
findings.evidence: Read pathApplied 2109-2138: the only early returns are for S_IGR_AFTER_APP/S_MMCE_BACKUP_PATH (2115-2120) and LANG/FONT (2124). Read dash_store.c:234-270 (dashStoreDefaults only rewrites dashCfg). Grep dashModalSetPreview: dash_internal.h:951 'void dashModalSetPreview(void (*fn)(int index))'; dashThemeSetPreset is 'void dashThemeSetPreset(int i)' at dash_internal.h:260; presetPreview is used only at 2840.

findings.title: settingsDraw repeats the value-column drawing block for choice rows and number/path rows
findings.problem: Both blocks compute maxw/vw/vx the same way, draw the same left/right arrow icons when focused, and then choose dashTextScroll or dashTextFit. Only the string and colour differ. The choice block also evaluates the same 'S_LANGUAGE or S_T_PRESET keeps the raw name, else localize' expression three times (4001, 4011, 4013), and settingsInput repeats it at 3829.
findings.fix: Compute the display string once into a local in the choice branch. Move the shared width/arrow/scroll-or-fit code into one static draw function taking the text, colour and an arrows flag, and call it from both branches.
findings.justification: Two 14-line copies become one ~14-line function plus two short calls, a net removal of about 10 lines, and the two kinds of row keep identical layout.
findings.benefit: ~10 lines removed net (INFERRED from cited ranges); negligible size change
findings.evidence: Read settingsDraw 3906-4073 and settingsInput 3810-3837; compared 4000-4013 with 4039-4052 line by line: the same arithmetic and icon calls, with different text and colour arguments.

findings.title: No-cloud #else branches in S_IGR_SYNC_MODE handling are never compiled
findings.problem: Both #else paths are only for builds without ETH and WLE_NATIVE_CLOUD. ps2.yaml:624-625 always defines both for the wLaunchELF target, the DS34 variant is generated from the same ps2.yaml, and the host test that compiles this file defines them too (tests/test_settings_navigation.py:31). No build compiles the #else code.
findings.fix: Delete the two #else branches and their #if/#endif lines, keeping the cloud code. A repo-wide decision to drop the WLE_NATIVE_CLOUD switch would remove the other guards in this file (17, 378, 775, 1172, 1846, 3342, 3857) as well.
findings.benefit: ~11 source lines removed; no ELF change, because the code is not compiled now (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep WLE_NATIVE_CLOUD|ETH in *.yaml/*.yml/*.py/*.sh: ps2.yaml:624-625 (defines), test_native_cloud.py:95 asserts the define is present, test_settings_navigation.py:31 defines both; brief section 2 says configure_ds34.py only swaps pad.c and adds DS34. No build file omits or undefines either macro.
